title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1979-11-05
lineage: Master played back on Nak Dragon> Grace Lunatec V3 (24/96)> Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe> Adobe Audition 2.0> (dither/downsample)> FLAC encoding
source: Master Audience Cassette; 2 Sennheiser 421s + Sennheiser 441> Nakamichi 550

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording that’s decent enough to enjoy a rare, imaginative second set featuring the unique Eyes → Estimated → Lost Sailor > St. of Circumstance → Franklin's sequence.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its relaxed pacing and inventive segues – especially the extended Estimated into Franklin’s jam and the one‑off pairing of Eyes, Estimated, Lost Sailor > St. of Circumstance and a solo Franklin’s. The audience recording is serviceable, not pristine, but it captures enough of the atmosphere to make the performance worthwhile.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑star ratings and highlighted strong musical moments despite noting only average audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio is described as okay but not great; the audience source captures the vibe but lacks hi‑fi clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The second set is unusually structured, weaving rare song pairings together in a relaxed, imaginative flow that keeps the performance fresh.
